scope: 1A-2A run of 2026-10-04, for the scope recorded in lqa.json (the rent provisions of Part IV, the Part V provisions by which a tenancy ends and the next begins, s. 26B, the s. 3 definitions they use, and the Regulations they depend on). Every document is gathered whole, except the Queensland comparative material, of which only the relevant provisions are gathered.
note: Assembled by an agent at 1A-2A on 2026-10-04 independently of the earlier canon subject subjects/au/wa/residential-tenancies-act: nothing in that folder was opened, read, listed or used, and every document here was fetched afresh from the official site, or supplied by the human for this run. Documents with integrity.local_path are held under sources/ (parliamentary material under sources/internal/, which its .gitignore keeps out of git). Documents with a sha256 and no local_path were downloaded and fingerprinted but not held, for the reason in no_copy_reason; the fingerprint lets a later copy be checked. Documents with an empty integrity were not retrieved, or are web pages whose content is recorded in their note. Word files were converted with the docx_text function of tools/fetch/fetch-source.py (imported directly); PDF files with pdftotext -layout (xpdf 4.00). Knowingly missing: the 2011 Bill's second reading speeches (refused; requested from the human before 3H); the debates on the 2023 Bill in consideration in detail (Assembly, 21 Feb 2024) and in committee (Council, 12 Mar 2024), its Supplementary Notice Papers and messages, and the 2011 Bill's print as passed, SNP and messages (not fetched after the refusal); the Residential Tenancies Amendment (Rent Cap) Bill 2026 (not fetched); the 2011 Act's commencement Gazettes (dates taken from the compilation table); the 2019 consultation paper of the review (not fetched); case law on the in-scope provisions (not searched; there is no open, scriptable WA source in this run's routes).
